title: 第十三章 一江祸水往东流

content_zh:
石千山说出这句话之后，只顾着自己摆出一个玉树临风又孤傲出群的造型，想要吸引乌倩倩的注意。却没有发现乌倩倩狠狠地瞪了他一眼：这家伙是不是有病？眼见得这事就能这么暂时揭过，他却说出这么决绝的话来！
李剑吟……岂是好惹的？更不要说，李剑吟还有一位父亲。他的父亲，可是自己的二师叔啊……天外楼除了长老阁之外宗主之下第二号人物！
你们的师傅孟师叔，也才第十而已……
一听石千山这句话，李剑吟血污破碎的脸上露出一个狰狞的笑意：“石千山，这话是你说的？”
“废话！”石千山大义凛然的道：“楚阳乃是我石千山的师弟！不管你是什么人，想要找我的师弟的麻烦，除非先过我石千山这一关！”
楚阳心中暗叫：说得好！石千山你真是太有才了！口中却感动的道：“大师兄，给你添麻烦了……”这叫砸死话尾，不留后患。嗯。
石千山潇洒的一摆手，昂然道：“楚师弟，你这是说的哪里话！咱们师兄弟之间，何谈麻烦之说？”居然又作出了一副怫然不悦的样子，似乎，楚阳不让他管这麻烦，就是看不起他一般……
一边的谈昙自然不知道楚阳在玩心眼，感动地险些哭了起来，抽噎着浓重的鼻音道：“大师兄……呜……你真好……”
“谈昙，你也是一样。你也是我师弟！若是你有事，为兄自然也会义不容辞的挺身而出！”石千山充满深情的道：“我做大师兄的，自然要为你们挡风遮雨。要不然，我们这么多年兄弟情分，难道都是假的不成？”
仗义！重情义！有担当！
这样的男子，天下女子谁不喜欢？
你乌倩倩……岂能例外？
石千山脸上一派严肃正气，却是偷偷的瞥了一眼乌倩倩，心中甚是得意。
就在这时，楚阳唯恐天下不乱的吆喝道：“不错，有我们大师兄在这里，你想欺负我？我大师兄可是我们天外楼年轻一辈的第一高手！”
“楚师弟，住口！”石千山一皱眉，急忙喝止，随即谦逊地道：“楚师弟，你对我盲目崇拜不要紧，但这话，可不能乱说啊……须知祸从口出，第一高手，呵呵，为兄哪里敢当？面前这位乌师妹，可就要比我强出好多啊……”
石千山语重心长的教诲，口中谦逊，心里却是轻飘飘的，连骨头也都轻了几两。
不枉了我平常一片苦心对你们；关键时刻，可真是给我涨面子啊。‘年轻一辈第一高手’几个字，自然是楚师弟对我一片盲目崇拜，但这正好证明了我的威望！
而且，我顺水推舟又轻轻拍了乌师妹一记马屁，既展现了我的风采，又博得了美人欢心……
石千山几乎可以想象得到乌倩倩对自己动心了……
石千山只顾着自己高兴，却浑然没看到，乌倩倩低着头迅速地为李剑吟包扎着伤口，脸上的表情却是越来越难看：此事，已经彻底大条了！只有赶紧回禀爹爹，让他老人家想办法。

唉，都怪这个石千山，你什么都搞不清楚，瞎充什么英雄？这下可倒好。李剑吟回去定然会添油加酱的一渲染，那就成了紫竹园和锁云峰的大矛盾了……
尤其还有李师叔超级护短，自己的儿子被打成这样，岂能善罢甘休？唉……
原本只是楚阳一个人，这件事情回禀之后，只需孟师叔等人都在，小小的惩戒楚阳一番挡挡李师叔的脸面，这事情就过去了。
但石千山一来，居然是狂风暴雨雷霆闪电，三言两语就将这件事搞到了无法再转圜的地步。而且，最离谱的是……原本的罪魁祸首楚阳，此刻啥事也没了，一切，都被石千山豪勇万状的扛在了肩上……
估计现在李剑吟恨楚阳都不如恨石千山来的厉害……
你说你算哪根葱啊……啥事都没你的，你胡乱的搅合什么！
“嘶……嘿嘿嘿……嘶嘶……”李剑吟一边痛得吸着冷气，一边冷笑：“石千山，“师姐，我们走吧。”李剑吟倒也硬气，居然一条腿支撑着跳了起来。怨毒的看了石千山一眼，强撑着离去。
他居然没有看楚阳！
毕竟，是自己不对在先，楚阳没什么错……而且，也是自己不小心踩进坑里扭断了脚把自己伤到了，跟人家貌似没啥关系……
再说，这事说起来也不是很光彩，还是以后偷偷的对付楚阳吧。不过这石千山……哼哼，弄不死他，我还真不姓李了……

content_en:
After Shi Qianshan said these words, he only focused on posing as a tree in the wind and aloof, trying to attract Wu Qianqian's attention. But he didn't notice that Wu Qianqian glared at him fiercely: Is this guy sick? Seeing that this matter could be solved temporarily, he said such decisive words!
Li Jianyin...isn't he easy to mess with? Not to mention, Li Jianyin also has a father. His father is his second uncle...the second most powerful person in Tianwai Tower, besides the Elder Pavilion, under the sect leader!
Your master, Master Meng, is only tenth...
Upon hearing Shi Qianshan's words, Li Jianyin's bloody and broken face showed a ferocious smile: "Shi Qianshan, is this what you said?"
"Nonsense!" Shi Qianshan said righteously and solemnly: "Chu Yang is my junior brother, Shi Qianshan! No matter who you are, if you want to cause trouble for my junior brother, you must first pass this test with me, Shi Qianshan!"
Chu Yang secretly shouted in his heart: Well said! Shi Qianshan, you are so talented! But he said movedly: "Senior Brother, I have caused trouble for you..." This is called ending the conversation without leaving any further trouble. Um.
Shi Qianshan waved his hand coolly and said proudly: "Junior brother Chu, what are you talking about! How can we talk about trouble between brothers?" He actually made a look of displeasure again, as if Chu Yang didn't let him take care of this trouble, just looking down on him...
Tan Tan, who was on the side, naturally didn't know that Chu Yang was playing tricks on him. He was so moved that he almost cried, sniffling and saying with a thick nasal voice: "Elder brother... oh... you are so kind..."
"Tan Tan, the same goes for you. You are also my junior brother! If something happens to you, my brother will naturally step forward without hesitation!" Shi Qianshan said affectionately: "As a senior brother, I will naturally protect you from wind and rain. Otherwise, our brotherhood for so many years, is it all fake?"
Honesty! Emphasis on friendship! Be responsible!
Who in the world wouldn’t like such a man?
You Wu Qianqian... how can you be an exception?
Shi Qianshan's face was serious and upright, but he glanced at Wu Qianqian secretly, feeling very proud in his heart.
At this moment, Chu Yang, fearing that the world would be in chaos, shouted: "Yes, our senior brother is here, you want to bully me? My senior brother is the number one master of the younger generation in our Tianwai Tower!"
"Junior Brother Chu, shut up!" Shi Qianshan frowned and hurriedly stopped, then said humbly: "Junior Brother Chu, it doesn't matter if you worship me blindly, but you can't say this nonsense... You must know that trouble comes from the mouth, the number one master, haha, how can I dare to be a brother? This Junior Sister Wu in front of me is much better than me..."
Shi Qianshan's teachings were serious and sincere, and his words were humble, but his heart was light and even his bones were a few ounces lighter.
It's not in vain that I usually take all the pains for you; at the critical moment, you really save my face. The words 'the number one master of the younger generation' naturally mean that Junior Brother Chu has blind admiration for me, but this just proves my prestige!
Moreover, I followed the trend and gently flattered Junior Sister Wu, which not only showed my style, but also won the beauty's favor...
Shi Qianshan could almost imagine that Wu Qianqian was attracted to him...
Shi Qianshan only focused on his own happiness, but didn't notice Wu Qianqian lowering her head and quickly bandaging Li Jianyin's wound, but the expression on her face became increasingly ugly: This matter has become a serious matter! I can only quickly report back to my father and let him find a solution.
Alas, it's all Shi Qianshan's fault. You can't figure anything out. Why are you pretending to be a hero? This is a good time. Li Jianyin will definitely add fuel to the fire when he goes back, and it will become a big conflict between Zizhuyuan and Suoyunfeng...
Especially Uncle Li, who is super protective of his shortcomings. How can he let it go when his own son is beaten like this? Alas...
Originally it was Chu Yang alone. After this matter was reported, only Master Meng and others were there to punish Chu Yang for a small amount of time.Uncle Li's face, this matter is over.
But when Shi Qianshan arrived, there was a violent storm, thunder and lightning, and in just a few words, the matter was brought to a point where it could no longer be reversed. Moreover, the most outrageous thing is... Chu Yang, the original culprit, has nothing to do now. Everything is carried on Shi Qianshan's shoulders heroically...
It is estimated that Li Jianyin hates Chu Yang as much as he hates Shi Qianshan now...
What kind of onion do you think you are... You don't have anything to do with it, why are you messing around!
"Hiss...hehehe...hiss..." Li Jianyin gasped in pain and sneered: "Shi Qianshan, "Senior sister, let's go. "Li Jianyin was so strong that he actually jumped up with one leg on his back. He looked at Shi Qianshan bitterly and forced himself to leave.
He didn't even look at Chu Yang!
After all, it was him who was wrong in the first place, and Chu Yang did nothing wrong... Moreover, he was the one who accidentally stepped into a pit and broke his foot, injuring himself. It seemed to have nothing to do with him...
Besides, it's not very honorable to talk about it. It's better to deal with Chu Yang secretly in the future. But this Shi Qianshan... Hum, if I can't kill him, my surname is really not Li anymore...
